I'm putting together a compilation for personal use on my iPod and possible uploading, but there's some metadata I can't fill in definitively. Everybody knows Rockapella sang "Carmen Sandiego," and David Seville/Ross Bagdasarian (father and son) did the voices for the Chipmunks show and theme song (both the shorts from the '60s and the 1983 NBC reboot), among other big names lending their talents to kids' cartoons and series (Mark Mothersbaugh for *Rugrats*; the B-52s for *Rocko's Modern Life*; Rita Moreno for *The Electric Company*, etc.).

But some tunes are more obscure, and take a lot of digging to find the artist credits, especially if they weren't listed during official production or were chalked down as just "studio singers" or instrumental performers. Here's some of the ones I'm looking for if anyone can fill me in.

* ***Wishbone*** **(PBS, 1995-99)** - "What's the Story, Wishbone?" A musician/producer/DJ named Ross Lara [claims on his Twitter](https://twitter.com/rosslara/status/292381401528025089) that he's the one who sang this. But he's not listed on IMDB as the vocalist, and his Wikipedia page doesn't mention Wishbone either. So I want to be sure it's him.

* ***Space Cases*** **(Nickelodeon, 1995-96)** - No idea whatsoever. I searched Google for "Who sang Space Cases theme song" and all I got was YouTube uploads of the intro. There are several versions about different characters and storylines, but they all seem to have the same vocalists -- I just don't know who they are.

* ***What Would You Do?*** **(Nickelodeon, 1991-93)** Early '90s game show with Marc Summers of *Double Dare* -- emphasis on the "dare" in this one. It's just a one-minute melodic rapping of the show's title \(["Wha-wha-wha-what would you do"](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s5VyJncSLlk)\), sounds like female vocalists but no idea the name.

* ***Princess Gwenevere*** **(U.S.)** / ***Princess Starla*** **(U.K./International)** **(Syndicated, 1995-96)** - Supposedly sung by two of the cast members, Corinne Orr and Jean Louisa Kelly (the actress from *Yes, Dear* and *Uncle Buck*). But, no confirmation, not even on the Jewel Riders official website. I don't know if the U.K. version has different performers either. I have the U.S. one where she's called Gwenevere.

* ***The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh*** **(Disney/ABC, 1988)** - Wikipedia doesn't list the name of the vocalist, just the songwriter, Steve Nelson. Some unconfirmed search results list Kenny Loggins (!) as the performer, while others say Nelson himself sang the theme song. I want to know which is true.

Thank you to anyone who can fill in the blanks.
